scoring_justification: Full recompute of the DMFT solver is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; we instead score structural properties (peak location and monotonicity) directly from the agent's output CSV curves, which are the raw artifacts. This matches the paper's main quantitative claims.

outputs.description: Raw gap and pairing amplitude vs Omega from Migdal-Eliashberg theory. The checker will identify the Boson energy that maximizes the gap and verify non-monotonicity.
Raw gap and pairing amplitude vs Omega from DMFT+ED. The checker will identify the Boson energy that maximizes the gap and verify non-monotonicity.

output_contract.notes: The solver's choice of numerical parameters (Matsubara cutoff, bath size, phonon truncation, convergence criteria) is not prescribed; the output must exhibit a single maximum and physically plausible curves.

steps.description: The Omega value that maximizes gap in me_data.csv must match the paper-reported optimal Boson energy for ME theory (~0.15).
The Omega value that maximizes gap in dmft_data.csv must match the paper-reported optimal Boson energy for DMFT (~0.4).
Both gap curves must be non-monotonic: strictly increasing to a global maximum, then strictly decreasing.
